topic: Anti-skid devices, purpose and operating principle of anti-skid unit.
syllabus_extract: Anti-skid devices, purpose and operating principle of anti-skid unit.
specific_objectives: 23.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe typical alighting gears of an aircraft and its construction.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of anti-skid system diagrams; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the landing gear?
How does a wheel rotate during landing?
What happens if a wheel locks up during braking?

development.content:
Purpose of anti-skid devices
Construction of typical landing gear
Role of wheel speed sensors
Hydraulic brake actuation system
Prevention of wheel lock-up

Operating principle of anti-skid unit
Signal processing in anti-skid logic
Modulation of brake pressure
System activation during rollout
Integration with flight control systems

Failure modes of anti-skid systems
Indications of anti-skid malfunction
Maintenance checks for anti-skid units
Troubleshooting common faults
Safety implications of system failure

summary_questions: Explain how the anti-skid unit prevents wheel lock-up.
Describe the sequence of events when anti-skid activates.
What are the consequences of an anti-skid system failure?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between typical landing gear configurations and their impact on anti-skid system design, to be discussed in LP 02.
